acceptedDivergences.reason: Structural difference. Figma has one variable with 10 modes; CSS has ten --icon-color-<mode> tokens. Verified equal.

Structural difference (D-49). There is no Figma variable: Figma reads a numeric variable bound to line height or letter spacing as pixels, so it cannot hold a percentage. The canonical value lives in the text styles (docs/data/figma-text-styles.json) and the percentage equals the CSS value after unit conversion. Revisit when Figma supports percentages in variables: create variables with these names and bind the styles; the CSS stays the same.

groups.label: State and status
groups.raw: STATE + STATUS TOKENS: Light mode (Figma Foundation v2.2)
groups.description: Disabled comes from tokens, never from opacity

groups.label: Icon color
groups.raw: ICON COLOR: Figma "Hope · Icon" / Icon/Color (10 modes)
groups.description: Each role aliases a semantic text token, so dark mode follows automatically. Icons still inherit currentColor by default; use .icon--<role> (css/components/icon.css) to pick a role

groups.label: Foundation rename (new names)
groups.description: Grammar: Property/Role/Level[ Modifier]. Level: Default, Secondary, Tertiary, Strong. Inverse = text/icon/border on the role's contrasting fill. Values below are the Light value; dark mode is parked, so the dark block does not override them yet unless stated

groups.label: Deprecated aliases
groups.raw: DEPRECATED ALIASES (2026-11, remove in a later MAJOR)
groups.description: Old names keep working and point at the new names. Do not use them in new code. Defined only in :root: the dark block overrides the new names on the same element, so the aliases follow dark mode

groups.label: Material (glass)
groups.description: Figma effect styles: Glass/rest = --blur-glass + --color-material-shadow-drop + inset highlight; Glass/hover = --blur-glass + --color-material-shadow-drop-hover + inset highlight

groups.label: Content width
groups.raw: CONTENT WIDTH: shared cap for section inner content
groups.description: Gutter formula (see .container in css/site/container.css): width shrinks to keep exactly --space-20 (80px) on each side up to the width where the cap takes over, so the minimum gutter never drops below 80px on any desktop width

groups.label: Header height
groups.raw: HEADER HEIGHT: fixed height of the sticky site header
groups.description: Kept as an explicit token (not left to content auto-sizing) so anything that needs to line up flush against the header's bottom edge, like the Featured Projects sticky section header, can reference the exact same value instead of guessing at it
